audit_reconstruction: Downloaded ZIP; confirmed 16 original pinned native raw result/intent/receipt hash chains, all 16 physical guard cases, 80 trace snapshots per run, eight frozen training receipt references, pre-action holdout forecasts and summary/status hashes; recomputed all four holdout MAEs exactly from raw native COM observations.
observation: Every measured shift had same sign as the command; all held-out trials returned within 0.1 mm of center under this fixed virtual-body control setting.
hypothesis: Friction-dependent predictive hypothesis won training leave-one-out by 10.75% over linear; it failed the stricter independent holdout comparison to the prior calibrated gain.
conclusion: No new predictive superiority over the already calibrated strong baseline is established. The experiment demonstrates a traceable epistemic workflow, NOT discovery of a new general physical law.
limits: The only world here is a deterministic flat-ground, bounded lateral-motion MuJoCo model.
No sensor noise, unknown environment, terrain, broad perception, or subjective feelings modeled.
The stronger earlier gain is a same-simulator historical control and does not imply physical-world relevance.
Draft PR remains unmerged; no actuation or changes to ChatGPT model weights or canonical body.
